shortDescription: Manipulate the PTF database via sqlite3

options.name: action
options.description: The action the C(ibmi_fix_repo) module takes towards the PTF database. C(add), C(update), C(find), C(delete) or C(clear).

options.name: checksum
options.description: Specified if check the ptf/group image files as well when checking database

options.name: parameters
options.description: The binding parameters for the action executed by the task.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of the target, C(single_ptf), C(ptf_group) or C(download_status).
